what: What does scMaSigPro need from a trajectory?
title: Frequently asked questions
text: One pseudotime value one path label per cell, raw counts cells. as_scmp() takes SingleCellExperiment two colData() columns, create_scmp() count matrix data frame. See Trajectory input vignette “Input contract” section ?assign_paths.

what: How do I analyse a Monocle3 trajectory?
title: Frequently asked questions

title: Frequently asked questions

what: Which bin rule should I use?
title: Frequently asked questions
text: Sturges’ rule, default, rule analyses article; drop_fac 1 gives fewer, larger bins, useful data many zeros, split_bins prune_bins even number cells per bin. Model tuning vignette describes every rule compares , ?estBinSize gives formulas.
